operations.name: UI component
operations.brief: Mounting, updating, rendering, unmounting, or resolving a UI component.

operations.name: Main UI thread blocked
operations.brief: A long task or long animation frame on the main UI thread.

operations.name: UI action
operations.brief: A user interaction that starts a new trace segment, described by the route it occurred on.

operations.name: UI interaction
operations.brief: A user interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP) or the Event Timing API, described by the element the user interacted with.

operations.name: Largest contentful paint
operations.brief: A Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) web vital measurement.

operations.name: Layout shift
operations.brief: A Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) web vital measurement, described by the first of its layout shift sources.
